evidence_class: Technical review of installed V2 physical surfaces
review_scope: Installed physical composition and its existing close-up camera set.

images.observation: Boiler casing, gauge, flue and the concrete floor keep distinct edges.
Shelf glazing, the chair and the lit doorway remain distinct across the wood floor.
Grout aligns across the corner and the pipe, tile trim and cistern silhouette remain separate.
Fine brick and mortar variation remains visible in the dark crop. This camera does not show the mechanism.
Floor seams converge beneath the furniture and the green terminal reads separately from the warm room.
The beam crosses the tile and plaster without hiding the grout. The curtain and terminal remain distinct.
Window trim, floorboards and furniture hold their edges in the warm light beside the resident.
Window trim and the shelf remain readable above the continuous board floor.
The bright spill retains a visible wall edge, with the cabinet, worktop and stove separately legible.
The open door edge, electrical fittings and conduit are separated against the plaster.
In the dark recess, the brass rail, tiled floor and stool edges remain visible. The inset subject stays dim.
The wall shelf, ornament and framed portrait remain visible in this low-light detail.
The underside wood grain, bracket and fasteners read separately, with the shelf and pictures retained.
The brass box grid and individual papers remain legible against the dark wainscot.
Radiator valve, fins and window treatment are visible. The foreground form partly obscures the fins.
The guard rail stays continuous around the raised drive, with legible shadows and lamp framing.
The tank shell and its ring rail remain distinct from the roof and the distant skyline.
The terminal's glass panels and the green floor spill read against the wood and the case board.
Tile joints, cistern hardware and trim remain visible in the service close-up.
The coloured residue reads against the board floor beneath the moving prop, inside the beam.
The appendages and lampshade separate against the board floor and the companion remains visible.
Crumbs, toaster controls and kettle remain distinct on the speckled counter surface.
Station plate, dark housing and metal disk remain visible against the mottled wall.
